body_html:
The Echo 3670-3 is a fully adjustable ergonomic office chair that lets each user dial in the fit for their own body — from lumbar height to seat angle to arm width. Built by Canadian manufacturer Global Furniture Group, this high-back multi-tilter pairs all-day comfort with the durability institutional workplaces demand. It is the kind of task chair you specify once and forget about for years.

Features

  • Independent, infinite-position back angle adjustment with infinite tilt-lock control
  • Height- and depth-adjustable Schukra lumbar support for targeted lower-back relief
  • Ratchet back with 2.25" height adjustments to match torso length
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment across a 17"–21" range
  • Forward seat angle adjustment and lock for posture variety
  • Tension adjustment tuned to the sitter's body weight
  • G5 height- and width-adjustable arms that slide and rotate inward and outward
  • High-back design with a 5-star base and carpet casters

Specifications

Overall 26"W x 26.5"D x 50"H, with a high back measuring 19"W x 28.5"–31"H and a 20.5"W x 18.5"D seat. Upholstered in Grade 1 fabric as standard, with upgrade grades available. ANSI/BIFMA compliant and backed by Global's commercial seating warranty — limited lifetime on the frame, base and mechanism, with five years on upholstery, foam and mesh. Made in Canada.

As an OECM-eligible supplier, Brant Business Interiors lets Ontario institutional buyers purchase the Echo without an open tender. Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON. Request a Quote below, or call 1-800-835-9565 to confirm fabric grades and volume pricing.
